# Vizio Marketing

> Vizio Marketing is a Canada-based investor awareness and capital markets marketing firm founded in 2018. We help OTCQB, OTCQX, Nasdaq, and growth-stage public companies increase investor visibility, communicate their investment thesis, and reach relevant investors in Canada and the United States.

## Company

- Name: Vizio Marketing
- Founded: 2018
- Website: https://viziomarketing.com
- Email: Info@viziomarketing.com
- Phone: +1(514)900-0022
- Address: 101-4762 Samson Boulevard, Laval, Quebec H7W 2H7, Canada
- Markets served: Canada, United States

## What Vizio Marketing does

Vizio Marketing provides investor relations strategy, corporate storytelling, digital investor awareness campaigns, AI-powered investor acquisition, permission-based investor email marketing, financial influencer and media promotion, capital markets advisory, and campaign reporting for public and growth-stage companies.

## Who we work with

Primarily OTCQB, OTCQX, Nasdaq small-cap, and growth-stage public companies seeking greater market awareness, shareholder engagement, liquidity, and capital access.

## Compliance note

Vizio Marketing does not provide investment advice, brokerage services, or investment recommendations. Campaigns are based on approved public information. The company does not guarantee share-price appreciation, trading volume, financing success, liquidity, or investment results.
